name: journal-segment
description: journal.seg: segment_index 0xFFFFFFFF, four STATE_TRANSITION frames, seq 0 and prev_crc32 0.
asserts: The journal is its own chain and scans from the zero state. Its reserved segment_index is an input to the segment key, so its key differs from capture segment 0's even though every other header field is the same; compare segment_key_hex with the capture vectors.
